name: Input
description: A single-line text field with a label, an optional hint, and an error message.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label, connected to the field.

props.name: hint
props.description: Helper text under the field, connected with aria-describedby.

props.name: error
props.description: Error message. Marks the field invalid and replaces the hint.

props.name: icon
props.description: Optional leading icon inside the field. Decorative.

props.name: ...props
props.description: All native input attributes, including type, placeholder, disabled and required.

a11y: The label is a real <label> tied to the input; placeholder text never replaces it.
Hint and error are linked with aria-describedby; an error sets aria-invalid="true".
The focus indicator has at least 3:1 contrast against the surface.
Error state is shown with text and border, not color alone.
